boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create a premium, production-ready Chinese Android native mobile product design sheet for 考匠 / AceExam AI learning. This is a TOTAL visual redesign of the AI area, NOT wireframes. Exactly FOUR separate flat app screens, equal portrait aspect ratio 393:852, arranged 2 by 2 on a square pale neutral board, with very narrow gutters. Make screens fill almost all the sheet, no phones, no perspective. Board headings only small numbered labels, no giant title. Small caption "界面设计 · 示例数据". Render all simplified Chinese sharply and accurately.
Art direction: refined editorial educational productivity app for ADULT professional exams, not childish, not gaming, not purple AI template. PAPER + INK + ELECTRIC BLUE. Off-white #F5F7FB background, pure white cards, ink navy #17243B, cobalt #2962F4, secondary gray #66748A, hairline #E5EAF2, soft blue #EDF3FF. Occasional muted green only for real positive state. Consistent Noto Sans SC typography, titles bold with excellent spacing. 4/8dp grid, 20dp screen margins, primary title 26sp, body 15sp, secondary 12sp. Cards radius 16dp, thin borders, almost no shadows. Small elegant line icons, restrained circular icon backplates, no emojis, no huge robot/brain illustration. Solid 52dp blue CTA, radius12. White bottom navigation with 5 items: 今日 / 练习 / AI 生成 / 考试 / 我的, third middle AI tab selected blue with a neat rounded blue square white sparkle icon, not a big oval. Status bar9:41. Logical spacing, clean dividers, NO massive repetitive cards, NO bulky bordered back buttons.
SCREEN 01 top-left: "AI 生成" home with subtle blue sparkle icon; trailing history outline clock with "记录". Short muted current context "网络工程师". Large left aligned editorial headline "下一组，练得更有针对性", 2 lines, visually well balanced; small subtitle "根据你的错题与答对记录，为你安排下一步". 
Compact white analysis card: small header "近30天学习画像" with text link "查看依据 ›"; 3 tidy metrics "128 / 已答不同题", "35 / 最近答错", "73% / 正确率". Fine mini mastery segments, text insight "优先巩固 子网划分、路由协议". Do NOT let analytics dominate half the screen.
Section header "选择这次的目标", four slim premium option cards 2x2, not enormous. Selected pale-blue "攻克不会的" / "补基础 · 做变式" with small recommended pill. Other "挑战更难的" / "稳定掌握后进阶"; "巩固易忘的" / "把答对的记得更久"; "综合提分" / "补弱项，也保住强项". Use target, trend, repeat, bar-chart line icons.
White single settings row "10 道题 · 不限时" with trailing "调整 ›". Bottom fixed CTA "查看专属方案", small note "先看方案与积分规则，再开始生成". Bottom nav fully visible, CTA never below the fold. 
SCREEN 02 top-right: native pushed page header small back chevron, centered "专属方案", no nav bar. Small blue mode tag "攻克不会的". Heading "从薄弱点，走向真正掌握". Compact evidence panel title "为什么这样安排" with two rows "子网划分 / 近10道不同题答错6道" and "路由协议 / 近8道不同题答错4道", small footnote "按不同题目的真实作答去重".
Beautiful minimal 3-step vertical training plan with tiny number markers and clear horizontal alignment: "01 补基础 3道", subtitle "先拆开概念，再把基础补牢"; "02 做变式 5道", subtitle "换一种设问，检验是否理解"; "03 迁移验证 2道", subtitle "用新情境确认掌握". Slim 3/5/2 distribution bar. 
"本次设置" compact list rows: "题目数量 10道"; "知识范围 2个知识点 ›"; "难度安排 由浅入深". 
Bottom white pricing info with blue shield icon: "积分使用确认", text "按生成与审核的实际用量结算；用量示例不是固定价格。失败题预扣按规则退回。". NO invented numerical cost.
Sticky primary CTA "确认方案，开始生成", quiet secondary "返回调整".
SCREEN03 bottom-left: native sheet-like full screen "学习分析" with back chevron. Heading "你该练什么，有据可查". Segmented period "近30天" selected and "历史表现" muted, NOT implying the app offers unimplemented external datasets. Small subtitle "128道不同题目 · 168次作答". Three compact evidence bars with labels "子网划分 40%","路由协议 50%","交换基础 86%" exact text "近期正确率". Confidence badge per point "样本充足" or "继续观察". Selected weak point detail: "子网划分" / "最近10道不同题：6错4对" / "建议先巩固地址范围与边界判断". Another note card "答对一次，不代表稳定掌握" and plain text "重复做同一题不会反复增加掌握证据；样本不足时先做诊断。".
At bottom link-style button "按这个范围制定方案". Clear visual hierarchy, no dense dashboard of tiny gray text.
SCREEN04 bottom-right: native selection page "调整练习" with back chevron. Section "训练目标" compact selected chip "攻克不会的". "题目数量" fixed "10道"; "练习时长" "不限时". Section "知识范围", search input with magnifier and placeholder "搜索章节或知识点", summary "已选2个 · 最多选择4个". Scrollable clean checkbox list of knowledge points with TWO-line hierarchy: selected "子网划分" small "网络层与地址规划", selected "路由协议" small "路由与广域网技术", unselected "交换与VLAN", unselected "网络安全基础", unselected "传输层协议". White sections with subtle dividers rather than giant cards.
Sticky bottom button "保存设置", secondary text link "交给AI推荐". No raw JSON, no code, no huge decorations. These four screens must be beautifully consistent and easy to reproduce using real React Native components.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create the SECOND design sheet of a coherent premium native Chinese adult exam-learning app, 考匠 / AceExam. Exactly FOUR flat mobile screens 393:852, 2x2 grid on pale neutral square board. Screens fill the board with narrow gutters, no device mockup, no perspective. Small labels 05/06/07/08 above each. Crisp readable simplified Chinese, Noto Sans SC style. Same PAPER + INK + ELECTRIC BLUE design: #F5F7FB background, pure white cards, #17243B ink navy, #2962F4 cobalt, #66748A secondary, #E5EAF2 borders, #EDF3FF blue tint, #178365 muted green. Cards16dp, CTA52dp radius12, small consistent outline icons, 20dp margins, strong title hierarchy, generous whitespace. No big pills, no giant robot, no gaming visuals. Back button is small chevron + optional short text; absolutely no bulky bordered back button. Native status bar9:41, safe bottom area. Accurate text, no pseudo-code or charts without meaning.
SCREEN05 top left, GENERATION MONITOR. Title "专属题组" with small back chevron, trailing "更多". Small mode tag "攻克不会的 · 10道". Bold headline "好题，正在为你准备". Subtext "每一道都先校验与审核，再交到你手中". Large beautiful circular progress ring, ink metric "4 / 10", label "已审核就绪" in middle, delicate blue progress 40%, small check motif not huge robot. Under ring compact horizontal status steps "生成 → 校验 → 独立审核 → 就绪", current independent-review step blue. Three compact rows each with tiny left status icon: "题目1–4 已审核，可作答" green check; "题目5 正在独立审核" cobalt spinner; "题目6–10 等待生成" gray clock. A small tinted reassurance strip with cloud/check outline "任务在服务器继续，离开页面也不会取消". Sticky primary CTA "先做已就绪的4题", subtle secondary link "返回，继续其他学习". NO bottom nav on this push-detail screen.
SCREEN06 top right, ACTIVE ANSWERING. Header chevron, centered "专属练习", right "交卷". Compact progress row "第3题 / 共10题" left and "已答2题" right, thin progress bar. Slim nonintrusive strip with live blue dot "已就绪8/10 · 后续持续生成", trailing chevron. Not a huge card pushing question down.
Small tag "单选题" and muted knowledge label "子网划分". White main question card, balanced larger typography: "一个 /26 的IPv4子网，最多可分配多少个可用主机地址？". Four full-width elegant answer options, evenly spaced, circular letter markers. "A 30", "B 32", "C 62", "D 64". None selected; no answer correctness hint.
A subtle text line with shield outline "已交付题目不会被替换". Sticky bottom area above safe edge contains equal-width outlined "上一题" and strong blue "下一题", then tiny green save-check "作答已保存". A compact accessible "答题卡" button in header/near question progress.
SCREEN07 bottom left, WAITING FOR NEXT REVIEWED QUESTION. Same active answering frame, header "AI 个性化考试", right "交卷". Timer block slim "剩余32:18" with small amber badge "已暂停计时". "已答4/30题". A calm central white panel, small tasteful outline hourglass on pale-blue circle, bold "下一道，正在认真审核", description "你已完成当前就绪的4题，后续通过审核后会自动加入。". Small subtle dotted progress animation depiction. Four steps tinyline "生成完成 · 校验完成 · 独立审核中 · 等待就绪". Transparent reassurance below "等待缺题不消耗考试时间" and "已答内容已保存，题号不会改变". Secondary actions "回看已答题" outlined and "暂存返回" text. Avoid a disabled giant button and huge loading overlay. Clear live status, no fake completion estimates.
SCREEN08 bottom right, ANSWER CARD as beautiful bottom sheet over subtly dimmed active exam. Sheet heading "答题卡", close x. Compact 3 metrics "已答2 / 可答6 / 待生成2" with tiny distinct semantic dots. 2 rows of five generously tappable numbered tiles1–10. 1,2 filled cobalt with white digits for answered;3 cobalt outlined with tiny current indicator;4–8 white border for ready;9,10 pale dashed for pending. Legend "已答 / 可作答 / 待生成" with shape distinctions, do not rely on color alone. An info strip "待生成题目通过审核后自动解锁". Primary button "继续作答". Secondary text "部分交卷需再次确认" not an actual destructive CTA. Maintain excellent hierarchy and reachable tap areas.
Small bottom board caption "界面设计 · 示例数据 · 生成与作答状态". This must look like a premium real implementable React Native application, not a generic form with boxed labels.

Use case: ui-mockup. THIRD premium Chinese mobile UI sheet for the same 考匠 / AceExam AI learning redesign. Exactly FOUR flat native app screens, 393:852 aspect ratio each, arranged 2x2 with narrow gutters. No device hardware, no perspective, no huge board title. Small labels09–12. Consistent PAPER + INK + ELECTRIC BLUE system: off-white #F5F7FB, white cards, navy #17243B, cobalt #2962F4, gray #66748A, border #E5EAF2, pale blue #EDF3FF, semantic green #178365, semantic muted red #BE4655. Noto Sans SC, clear Chinese, 26sp headings, 15sp body, 12sp supporting, 20dp horizontal padding, 16dp card radius, restrained thin borders, subtle/no shadows, small line icons, 52dp CTA radius12. Adult exam productivity, sophisticated and practical. Never huge pill cards, never a robot mascot.
SCREEN09 top-left "练习结果", back chevron, trailing share icon as optional decorative not promised social auto-post. Small green outline check on pale-green circle. Editorial headline "这次的进步，已经留下记录". Elegant score ring with "8 / 10" center, small label "本组答对". Below a tidy 3-column white stats panel "80% 正确率", "12分36秒 用时", "2个 待巩固". Compact insight panel heading "下一步，先巩固这里", two small rows "子网划分 1题答错" and "路由协议 1题答错", each chevron.
Secondary card "这组题怎么来的" / "攻克不会的 · 补基础→变式→迁移验证". Sticky primary CTA "查看答案与解析", secondary link "回到AI生成". Small footer "AI个性化训练成绩，非官方考试评分". No exaggerated grade or guarantee.
SCREEN10 top-right "答案与解析", back chevron. Two-chip filter "全部10题" / selected "错题2题". Large simple question index "第3题 · 子网划分". Question card exact stem "一个 /26 的IPv4子网，最多可分配多少个可用主机地址？". Answer summary horizontal blocks: subtle red "你的答案 B · 32", subtle green "正确答案 C · 62". Explanation section title "为什么选C", body "主机位为32−26=6位，可用主机地址数为2⁶−2=62个。网络地址与广播地址不能分配给普通主机。". Small learning-point tag "主机位与地址边界". Secondary folded row "查看全部选项 ›". Bottom actions outlined "上一题" and primary "下一道错题". Clean typography, no wall of text, real correct calculation.
SCREEN11 bottom-left "生成记录", back chevron. Segmented tabs "练习" selected / "考试". Group label "今天". Three slim attractive white list cards with small cobalt icon and clean hierarchy:
"子网划分 · 专属练习" badge green "已完成", subtitle "攻克不会的 · 10道 · 答对8道", trailing chevron.
"网络基础 · 专属练习" badge blue "生成中", subtitle "已就绪4/10题 · 可先作答", tiny progress line.
"路由协议 · 专属练习" badge amber "待恢复", subtitle "已保留6道审核题 · 查看原因".
Group label "更早". One card "综合巩固 · 10道" gray badge "已停止", subtitle "已就绪题目仍可继续". Subtle info footer "记录按账号和证书隔离". Do not place several giant action buttons in every row. Bottom quiet "返回AI生成".
SCREEN12 bottom-right EXAM SETUP, title "考试", trailing clock "记录". Native segmented tabs "题库组卷" / blue selected "AI个性化". Editorial heading "一场更适合你的模拟考". Subtitle "复用你的学习画像，先定方案，再逐题交付". Compact recommendation banner "建议：攻克不会的" / "优先检验子网划分与路由协议". Four slim goal chips in2x2 "攻克不会的" selected,"挑战更难的","巩固易忘的","综合提分". A clean white configuration panel title "考试设置": count selector "10 / 20 / 30 / 50题",30selected; duration selector "20 / 40 / 60 / 90分",40selected; range row "知识范围 跟随分析 ›". Small info panel with three compact rows "首批3题就绪即可开考", "等待缺题由服务器暂停计时", "断线可续接，作答自动保存". Sticky solid CTA "查看组卷方案". Bottom five-item nav "今日 / 练习 / AI生成 / 考试 / 我的"; fourth考试selected, centerAIinactive.
Tiny board caption "界面设计 · 示例数据 · 结果、解析、记录与考试". Everything must be plausibly buildable with real React Native primitives and available backend fields.

Use case: ui-mockup. FOURTH UI design sheet, covering exception and empty states for the same premium Chinese adult exam app 考匠 / AceExam AI redesign. Four equal flat native phone screens in2x2 grid, 393:852 each, narrow gutters, no device frame or perspective, small labels13–16. PAPER+INK+ELECTRIC BLUE system identical across all: #F5F7FB background, white, navy #17243B, cobalt #2962F4, gray #66748A, border #E5EAF2, soft blue #EDF3FF, muted amber #A66B12, red #BE4655. Chinese system sans Noto Sans SC, editorial 26sp headline, 15sp body, generous whitespace and restrained16dp cards. Beautiful, calm, practical, not a generic error alert. 20dp margins, primary CTA52dp radius12, small coherent line icons, no robots, no huge emoji. Native status bar9:41.
SCREEN13 top left EMPTY/COLD START AI HOME. Header small sparkle icon, "AI生成", trailing "记录". Small context "当前证书 · 尚无足够作答证据". Strong headline "先测一小组，找到你的起点". Quiet subtitle "还不急着判断你会不会，先用基础与中等题建立学习画像。". Elegant small abstract learning path motif of three nodes linked by thin cobalt line inside a light panel; no cartoon. Compact info "0道不同题目 / 画像待建立", not fake percentages, no invented weak-point recommendations. Three simple guidance rows with small01/02/03 markers: "做10道诊断题","了解真实掌握情况","再安排个性化训练". Four goal tiles remain available but subdued; selected tile label "先做诊断" with blue badge "推荐起步". A compact notice "数据不足时，不直接认定稳定掌握，也不直接加难。". Primary sticky CTA "查看诊断方案". Bottom nav 今日/练习/AI生成/考试/我的 with middle selected.
SCREEN14 top right CONNECTION INTERRUPTION WHILE ANSWERING. Header chevron, "专属练习", right "交卷". Slim amber banner with cloud-off line icon "实时连接暂不可用" and supporting "作答已暂存，待恢复后同步". Top progress "第3题 / 共10题", "已就绪8题". Show existing readable question card and four options, selected option B pale-blue, not marked correct/wrong. Exact stem same /26 IPv4 usable-host question, options30/32/62/64. Below a compact storage status row amber clock "本机暂存1条，尚未收到服务器确认". An unobtrusive secondary button "重试同步". Footer previous/next buttons remain available for already loaded questions. Small footer "连接中断不会取消服务端生成任务". No message claiming server saved when only local.
SCREEN15 bottom left QUALITY/GENERATION FAILURE PARTIAL. Header back, title "生成待恢复". Small amber outline shield/exclamation symbol. Strong headline "这道题，还没达到交付标准". Body "已审核的6道题仍然保留；未通过的候选不会混入题组。". Compact white progress card "已就绪6 / 10道" withblue60%bar, two rows "6道 已审核并保存" green; "4道 尚未交付" amber. Separate cause block "当前原因" with sample text "后续题目审核未通过，已达到自动重试上限。". Reassurance strip "不降低质量凑题量，不替换已交付题目。". Available actions strong "继续已就绪题目", secondary outlined "尝试恢复剩余题目", quiet text "停止后续生成". Small footnote "达到重试上限时，会明确说明；部分交卷需再次确认。". Avoid suggesting retry is guaranteed to work.
SCREEN16 bottom right INSUFFICIENT POINTS DURING CONFIRMATION. Underlying dedicated "专属方案" page lightly dimmed, with a clean bottom confirmation sheet. Sheet top grabber, small wallet outline icon, title "积分暂时不足". Text "已生成题目与作答不会丢失。你可以先领取可用积分，再回来继续。". Two clean summary rows "本次方式 按实际用量结算"; "已交付部分 按实际账本结算". Do not fabricate balance numbers or exact cost. Pale-blue explainer "预扣不是最终费用，失败题按规则退回预扣。". Main CTA "前往积分中心", secondary outlined "返回方案", explicit close x. No forced subscription, no fake payment gateway, no charged retry implied.
Bottom board caption "界面设计 · 空状态、暂存、质量失败与积分不足". Maintain consistent visual style and readable exact Chinese, with actions and messages that can be implemented from real task/account state.
boards.correction:
Edit this existing four-screen exception-state design board. Preserve the premium visual style, all layouts, colors, typography and all other screens exactly. Change ONLY the four goal tiles in the TOP LEFT cold-start screen:
Top left selected tile title "攻克不会的", subtitle "样本不足，先做诊断", badge "推荐起步".
Top right tile title "挑战更难的", subtitle "稳定掌握后再进阶".
Bottom left tile title "巩固易忘的", subtitle "把答对的记得更久".
Bottom right tile title "综合提分", subtitle "补弱项，也保住强项".
Remove the unsupported words "真题演练" and "专项练习" and "模拟考试" from these tiles. The app has exactly these four personalized strategies, even with no learning history. Keep the bottom primary CTA "查看诊断方案". Keep all other components unchanged. All data remain design examples, never imply AI generated questions are official past papers.
